title: Refuting random 3SAT-instances on $O(n)$ clauses (weak form)
exact_target: Can a polynomial-time algorithm reliably recognize random formulas with only a constant number of clauses per variable while never accepting a formula whose clauses are almost all simultaneously satisfiable?
